scope.qualification: 40 configured cabinets use 7 conventional primary winning families plus cabinet-specific feature flows. These are not 40 unrelated fundamental slot mechanisms. Four primary families within each project differ; primary families are shared across projects.
scope.independentProductAcceptance: pending; the current family matrix is not evidence of App Store acceptance or full product differentiation.

finalSourceRuleAndPrimaryChecks.scope: Final mathematical source checks reported for all ten projects; not a native build or full UI acceptance.

featureMathHandoff.scope: 240,000 natural spins across 40 modes before final split calibration; reachability and conservation evidence, not certified RTP or final playback quality.

finalNaturalObservation.scope: 100,000 paid spins each for F17-3, F19-3, F22-1 and F22-4; 400,000 total. Bounded samples do not establish theoretical maxima, certified RTP, frame rate or visual quality.

finalBuild.scope: Final browser artifact built successfully; not an iOS archive, native-device acceptance or submission certification.
finalBuild.buildLogQualification: Cocos build completion recorded. Some logs contain editor/process shutdown warnings after successful build; compiled-positive fixtures separately verify the produced bundles.

finalUiAcceptance.reason: Rule geometry and pagination checks pass across all ten projects; final targeted normal-amount checks also pass 400 states. Complete visual acceptance remains pending for supporting small text, large-amount stress and real-device review.

realDeviceAndTestFlight.reason: No recorded native real-device, Sandbox purchase/refund/retry or TestFlight acceptance in the retained release documents.

compiledPositiveFixtures.scope: Existing result records: each final compiled evaluator produced positive, finite awards with valid positions for an explicit winning fixture. Not a comprehensive statistical or end-to-end UI test.

paytableReferenceChecks.scope: 30 commands across ten projects: targeted reference/rounding checks, rule contracts and typechecks; 32,391 targeted assertions, including 242 small positive references.

collectorBrowserInteraction.scope: Browser coordinate-touch interactions, not a physical iPhone or TestFlight acceptance. All reported cases finish and return idle; report covers hint bounds, final grid, wallet and transient-state cleanup.
